caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with black Greek-key trim, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled edges.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
